G20196.d:
γίγνομαι, see: γίνομαι.
  γίνομαι, Ion. and κοινή for Att. γίγν- (M. Pr., 47; Bl., §6, 8 Mayser, 166 f.), 
 [in LXX chiefly for היה ;] 
  1. of persons, things occurrences, to come into being, be born, arise, come on: John.1:15 8:58, 1 Cor.15:37; a first appearance in public, Mark.1:4, John.1:6, al.; before ἐκ (of birth), Rom.1:3, Gal.4:4; διά, John.1:3; βροντή, John.12:29; σεισμός, Rev.6:12; γογγυσμός, Acts.6:1; χαρά, Acts.8:8, many other similar exx.; ἡμέρα, Luke.22:66, al.; ὀψέ, Mark.11:19; πρωΐα, Matt.27:1; νύξ, Acts.27:27. 
  2. Of events, to come to pass, take place, happen: Matt.5:18, Mark.5:14, Luke.1:20 2:15, Acts.4:21, 2 Tim.2:18, al.; μὴ γένοιτο [LXX for חָלִילָה, John.22:29, al.], far be it, God forbid: Rom.3:4 (ICC, in l.), 1 Cor.6:15 and frequently in Pl.; καὶ ἐγένετο, ἐγένετο δέ ([in LXX for וַיְהִי ;] see Burton, 142 f.; M, Pr., 16f.; Dalman, Words, 32 f.; Robertson, Gr., 1042 f.), with indic, Matt.7:28, Luke.1:8, al.; before καί and indic., Luke.8:1, Acts.5:7, al.; with accusative and inf., Mark.2:23, Luke.3:21, al.; ὡς δὲ ἐγένετο, before τοῦ with inf., Acts.10:25; with dative of person(s), to befall one: with inf., Acts.20:16; with accusative and inf., Acts.22:6; with adv., εὖ, Eph.6:3; τ́ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ (Field, Notes, 115), Acts.7:40 (LXX); before εἰς, Acts.28:6. 
  3. to be made, done, performed, observed, enacted, ordained, etc.: Matt.6:10 19:8, Mark.2:27 11:23, Acts.19:26, al.; before διά with genitive, Mark.6:2, Acts.2:43; ὑπό, Luke.13:17; ἐκ, Luke.4:23; ἐν, 1 Cor.9:15; ἀπογραφή, Luke.2:2; ἀνάκρισις Acts.25:26; ἄφεσις, Heb.9:22; ὁ νόμος, Gal.3:17; τὸ πάσχα, Matt.26:2. 
  4. to become, be made, come to be: with pred., Matt.4:3, Luke.4:3, John.2:9, 1 Cor.13:11, al.; before ὡς, ὡσεί, Matt.10:25, Mark.9:26; εἰς (M, Pr., 71f.), Mark.12:1o, al.; with genitive Rev.11:15; id., of age, Luke.2:42; with dative, γ. ἀνδρί ([LXX for הָיָה לְאִישׁ, Rut.1:12, al. ;] see Field, Notes, 156), Rom.7:3, 4; before ἐν, Acts.22:17, Rev.1:10, al.; ἐπάνω, Luke.19:19; μετά, with genitive, Mrk.16:[10], Acts.9:19; before εἰς, ἐπί (Field, Notes, 135), κατά (ib., 62), with accusative of place, Acts.20:16 21:35 27:7, al.; before ἐκ, Mark.9:7, Luke.3:22, 2 Thess.2:7, al. Aoristic pf. γέγονα (M, Pr., 52, 145f.; Field, Notes, 1f.), Matt.25:6, Luke.10:36, al. Aor. ἐγενήθη (for ἐγένετο, M, Pr., 139f.; Mayser, 379), Matt.11:23, al.
